# Manhattan Residences

> Manhattan Residences (also called Manhattan Towers or Mohtisham Manhattan) is a luxury residential tower in Hampankatta, the Central Business District of Mangalore (Mangaluru), Karnataka, India. It is a project by Mohtisham Complexes Pvt. Ltd. and Allegro Builders & Developers, designed by a Dubai-based team of architects.

## Residences

- 3 BHK Apartment: 2,915 sq. ft. (odd floors) / 2,970 sq. ft. (even floors)
- 4 BHK Apartment: 4,015 sq. ft. (odd floors) / 3,915 sq. ft. (even floors)
- 4 BHK Duplex Sky Villa: 5,170 sq. ft., 34th floor and above
- 5 BHK Duplex Sky Villa (penthouse duplex): 6,915 sq. ft., 34th floor and above

## Amenities

Residents' Clubhouse, heated indoor swimming pool, gym, home theatre, Sky Lounge Café with panoramic city views, squash court, spa with steam and sauna, game room, kids' play area, grand lobby.

## Location

Hampankatta, Mangaluru, Karnataka. Coordinates 12.8688368, 74.8446712.
Travel times: Milagres Church 1 min, St. Aloysius College 3 min, City Centre Mall 4 min, Father Muller Hospital 8 min, Mangala Stadium 14 min, Tannirbhavi Beach 26 min, Mangalore International Airport 30 min.
